faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions about HCM services? Find your answers here.

items.a: HCM provides end-to-end e-commerce solutions: Marketplace Activation (MPA), Marketplace Optimization (MPO), Affiliate & KOL Management, Ads Management, Social Media Management, Digital Creative Assets, and Product Live Streaming.

items.q: Is HCM only a fit for large brands?
items.a: No. HCM supports businesses at every stage — from brands just getting started in e-commerce, to brands looking to lift sales, to brands ready to scale up.

items.q: What sets HCM apart from other marketing agencies?
items.a: HCM acts as a growth partner, not just a service provider. We understand that every brand faces different challenges, so each strategy is tailored to your business conditions, target market, and brand goals.

items.q: Does HCM work on a performance-based model?
items.a: Yes. Beyond the Management Fee scheme, HCM also offers brand partnerships through business-growth-oriented strategies (commission sharing). T&Cs apply.

items.q: How long does it take to see results?
items.a: Every brand is different — it depends on product category, store readiness, marketing budget, and the strategy being executed. HCM always starts by analyzing your brand's condition to define a realistic strategy and targets.

items.q: How do I start working with HCM?
items.a: Simply consult your brand needs via WhatsApp. The HCM team will help map your business conditions and recommend the most suitable strategy.
